notes.title: Let's celebrate World Animal Day with Animal Week! 🥳
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

We are excited to announce that our game is a part of Animal Week on Steam, starting today until October 10, 2024! 😻 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/acbfcdb9ad6540118cb53041410bc50decc2f9e8.png

This special event is organized to celebrate World Animal Day and aims to raise awareness about animal welfare and conservation. During Animal Week, our game will be featured alongside a diverse selection of animal-themed games, offering players unique experiences that highlight the beauty and importance of the animals and environment worldwide.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2658510/view/4660753243321301287

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/6407467d84d8cac0ff8bec4fca835c71f4296b0d.png

We are proud to support efforts to protect wildlife and their habitats by participating in this event. This initiative promises to provide an educational and entertaining experience for all players. 🤝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/eb19fe493d76b11305b4420230767da78aeeadac.png

As part of our commitment, a portion of the revenue generated from our game during Animal Week will be donated to animal welfare organizations. 🥰

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e7160665a65210e6cdcc6e8bb638baef925e3d4a.png

The main partner of Animal Week is WWF Poland, a leading conservation organization, that brings their extensive expertise in wildlife protection and environmental sustainability. Their involvement in this event underscores the shared commitment of both organizations to foster a deeper understanding of animal conservation issues among the gaming community.

Read more about helping the TIGER 🐯 click the banner below 👇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/0f02d1c40abac7b658288ca99db9557afc693ce7.png

Think globally act locally 🌍

Let’s make a difference together through the power of gaming! 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♂️ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/91f3a34156d093b6bf3cf365dcaa294e9aff9a56.png

Have Fun!!
Games Incubator Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey Zookeepers! 🦁🌿

We’ve got some awesome news for you! We just dropped a new update for Zoo Simulator Prologue and we’re excited to share all the details with you! 🎉

First off, we've been working tirelessly on optimization since the prologue's release, and now we're bringing you the results of all that hard work! 💪🔥

🔧 WHAT’S NEW?

 Game should no longer crash when opening Zoo in Turkish language

We want to give a huge thank you to all of you for your engagement and support. It’s thanks to your feedback and patience that we can keep improving our game. You guys are amazing! 🙌❤️

Stay tuned for more updates and keep your eyes peeled. We promise this is just the beginning and the best is yet to come!




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/20a8a9f39e48345f94f87663b46aa9ad5f89557a.png

Thanks for being with us. See you in the zoo! 🐘🦒🦓

See you soon,
ZOO Simulator Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello ZOO Managers! 👋

The update is live! 💪 We’ve finished working on one of the things you’ve been pointing out as the biggest obstacle to being able to fully enjoy the game- performance issues! 🔥

The new update brings a lot of optimization to the game- mostly in terms of RAM and VRAM usage but this will also help to keep your FPS higher and more stable!



Here are all the other changes we’re introducing to the game:

 Fixed the crashes in Japanese, Korean and Turkish translations,
 Adjusted the default mouse sensitivity; (those of you who adjusted it on your own may have to do it again as the game may change it to the new default setting),
 Added reactions of the animals to the washer 👍,
 Added information about the size of the enclosure to the enclosure info cards, 
 Fixed the Steam Deck support - some elements of the UI have been resized and the cutscene at the end of the tutorial has been fixed to display properly 

We’re doing our best to deliver full support for the Steam Deck, introduce the fixes to the Prologue and all that while working on the full version. That’s why we’re extremely grateful for your support and patience! ❤️‍ If you have any suggestion, would like to leave us your feedback or simply chat about the game then please, join our discord- we’ll gladly hear from you! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/20a8a9f39e48345f94f87663b46aa9ad5f89557a.png


See you soon,
ZOO Simulator Team

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1
notes.content:
At the very beginning, we would like to thank each of you for your feedback, opinions, and ideas. 🤝

💡 We are constantly writing down all your suggestions, and the bugs you have found and the whole team is working to fix them. Today we come to you with the first patch to Prologue.

FULL LIST OF CHANGES IN PATCH 1.0.1
 Increase start budget
 Rebind controls in Decoration/Building System to more intuitive
 Add an Open Tablet button hint (On the inventory bar)
 Add a thin blue outline on old decoration when are any in enclosure - when the player enters the enclosure
 Add NEW label on every new opinion
 Add green bloom around enclosure button in adopt view when - enclosure fits to current selected animal
 Fix floating animal cage in 2nd enclosure
 Fix error with save after loading game with no decoration after we have any
 Add gender symbol on Animal Name Window
 Optimization


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/20a8a9f39e48345f94f87663b46aa9ad5f89557a.png

Thank you once again,
Zoo Simulator Team
